title: Photo removal requests
desc: How to ask for a photo of you to be removed from Everett Allen Photography.
lede: If you're in a photo and want it taken down, just ask.
body:
I want everyone in my galleries to be comfortable with how they appear. If you would like a photo of you removed, I'll take it down. You don't need to give a reason.

**How to ask**

1. Open the gallery and the photo, and copy the page address (the link) from your browser.
2. Send it to me on the [contact page](/contact/), along with your name so I can follow up.
3. I'll remove the photo promptly and let you know when it's done.

If you can't find the link, just tell me which event and what you were wearing, and I'll find it.
